payload.body: Shipped localization hooks: @fricken/protocol ErrorLocalizer + English default message table + localizeErrorCode (code/envelope -> localized string, fallback chain region->base->English->envelope msg->[code], {token} interpolation from details, function messages). @fricken/design-web FrickLabelsProvider/useComponentLabels localize built-in component chrome (workspace inspector Close button) with English defaults + inline override. Wire protocol (error codes) unchanged. New tests in both packages. typecheck exit 0; protocol 93/93, design-web 37/37 green.
